data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure, order and parameters (country, capital) as the true workflow, adding only a time-zone suffix and a disambiguation click. It is still not fully automatable as written, because it lists the capital as something to read from the infobox while also requiring it as an input parameter, and it leaves the note's population, language, currency and time values as extracted placeholders.
